entry.note: Enriched with Crossref/Handle-verified DOI 10.1142/s0218216598000243, issue 4, and arXiv q-alg/9607027 (J. Knot Theory Ramifications 7 (1998), no. 4, 463-487).

relevance.rationale: Constructs minimal Young-symmetrizer Hecke idempotents, satellite cabling maps into H_{kn}(q), and framed HOMFLYPT Young-diagram satellite eigenfunctions.

keyResults.statement: Cabled satellite braids decompose into Young-diagram eigencomponents of the full twist with eigenvalues q^{2 sum c(box)}.
keyResults.useForFolio: Underlies the 2-cable (H_6(q_0)) satellite trace and zero-writhe framing projection in computations/probes/untapped_algebraic_invariants_proton_probe.py and QOU/StandardModel/LeptonFramedGNSAndStrainOrder.lean.

proposedActions.rationale: Evaluated at 85 dps in computations/probes/untapped_algebraic_invariants_proton_probe.py (2-cable colored Jones and HOMFLYPT satellites).
